what_just_landed.detail: Bound single-shelf and stack search accept distinct=DistinctSources(key): at most limit results, one per source, with the consumer's own source key and accepted-version rule, over the same ranked candidates and single rerank call as an ordinary search.
what_just_landed.title: One result per source

what_just_landed.detail: A candidate heads its source only after Biblios's own checks serve it and the key accepts it, so a stale or rejected top candidate never hides a valid sibling; every selected hit is re-read when the answer is assembled and withheld, not replaced, if it changed.
what_just_landed.title: Authority before grouping

what_just_landed.detail: A pool with fewer distinct sources returns fewer results, and DistinctReport says how many were walked, refused, duplicated, selected and returned.
